parameters.content:
## Replace this node

Swap this Sticky Note area for a real notification node once you know where recaps should go, e.g.:

- Slack node -> post `{{$json.recap_message}}` to a channel
- Gmail/Send Email node -> email the student their recap
- Google Sheets node -> append a row for a coach dashboard

The Webhook and Set nodes upstream already give you a clean, ready-to-use `recap_message` field plus the full raw payload from SpeakSense.
